content: Super Smash Bros. fans, this one’s for you. Peripheral maker 8BitDo just revealed the GC Bluetooth Gamepad, a wireless spin on the GameCube controller meant for Nintendp Switch, Switch 2, and Windows PC. It’s available in the GameCube’s iconic purple-and-orange color palette and features the "classic GC design and iconic button layout," according to its product description. The controller can connect wirelessly via Bluetooth 5.0 or a 2.4 GHz adapter, and has wired support via a USB-C cable. All three connection types work with the original Switch and Switch 2, while only wired and 2.4 GHz wireless connections work on PC. The controller goes for $49.99 and ships on Dec. 10, 2026.
